summary: Validated OneDrive (Make.com webhook) integration for Report PDF download endpoint. All 8 backend tests passed (100% success). Confirmed: (a) GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf?download=1 returns PDF (200, application/pdf, Content-Disposition: attachment) AND fires real asyncio background upload — backend.err.log shows 'services.onedrive - INFO - OneDrive upload OK [report] <filename> -> 200' within ~5s for both Bearer-header and ?token= query-param auth modes; (b) GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf (no download) returns PDF inline with NO upload log (waited 8s) — webhook correctly suppressed; (c) GET /api/timesheets/{id}/pdf?download=1 returns PDF attachment but does NOT log a webhook upload because MAKE_WEBHOOK_TIMESHEETS_URL is empty (gracefully skipped via env check in services/onedrive.py); (d) /api/reports/{id}/pdf without token returns 401, invalid token returns 401; (e) basic CRUD GET /api/reports and GET /api/reports/{id} still work. Make.com webhook returned 200 on both real upload attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: services/onedrive.py is well-designed: try/except wraps entire body and returns False instead of raising — fire-and-forget background task cannot break the PDF response. Verified by code review (no need to corrupt env).
routes/reports.py uses asyncio.create_task on a copy of the PDF bytes (final_buffer.getvalue() before seek(0)), so the StreamingResponse buffer is not consumed by the upload — correct.
routes/reports.py is large (~1456 lines). Consider splitting PDF generation logic from CRUD routes into a dedicated module to improve maintainability (non-blocking).

The `download` query param is treated as truthy on any non-empty string (e.g., ?download=0 would also trigger upload). If strict semantics are wanted, parse to int/bool. Currently matches the documented behaviour (download=1).
seed_data_creation: None — reused 3 existing reports and 33 existing timesheets in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each successful run of this test file produces 2 real uploads to the user's OneDrive (Make.com webhook is live, toggle ON). The 2 PDFs overwrite the same target file (2603-25 - Constellation - Atlantic Star - RT - Termografia.pdf). Webhook log line to look for: 'services.onedrive - INFO - OneDrive upload OK [report] ...'. Backend log path: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. The asyncio task takes 2–10s to complete after the request returns, so always wait/poll before asserting log content. MAKE_WEBHOOK_TIMESHEETS_URL is intentionally empty in /app/backend/.env; do not fill it unless the feature is extended.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Feature works end-to-end against the real Make.com webhook.
